title: A job run by a server or CI executor names the executor's operator, not the submitter, in its KB-Operator trailer and operator credential
goal: Sync.pull keeps the submitter (the central record's operator, Remote.owner) as the operator of the mirrored job, so KB_JOB_OPERATOR, the KB-Operator trailer and the credential path CRED_DIR/operator/<operator> name the submitter on a server or CI executor, and the executor's own operator id is never written over it

run: s=open('_tools/kj_exec.py').read(); assert 'mirrored.update(host=self.host, clone=self.clone, operator=self.operator)' not in s

repro_reason: the wrong operator appears only with a central queue and a server executor; the repro reads the assignment that overwrites it, and the fix carries a planted-queue check
